o8.why: The asterisk (Si-Ce-Al) curve runs with Si-Al-1/2 (about 2650 to 850 NTU); the curve near Al is the x-marked Si-Al-3, which the reader misassigned.

o11.why: F8a shows one dense particle pile at the top and F8b shows several separate small groups; the reader described sizes and left out the distribution.

o22.why: F8b shows round cavities of about 300-450 nm on the right against the 500 nm bar; the reader's 40-76 nm values are the annotated particles, not the cavities.

o19.why: In F11c, the tan brushed patches are bare steel and dark means coating: dry S2 is fully dark, wet S2 has a small patch, wet Blank is fully bare. The reader inverted the colours.
